posts.author: james5272
posts.body:
I'm having the exact same issue, as are others if my Steam forum post is anything to go by.  I've been having it since I got RPG Maker when most recent version was 1.8.1.  I fixed it by going to 1.8.0.  Now 1.9 is out and I was hoping they fixed it, but they haven't.  I'm on a Nvidia GPU, no option for anything else to troubleshoot if it's Nvidia exclusive for me as well.
Screenshot of right click menu being black - it will also sometimes instead flicker, or have text so big that it doesn't fit everything in the window.
EDIT: I can see this issue going back to 2023 on Google for MZ, seems it was an issue for people for a while in MV as well.
EDIT: Okay, I have played with all Properties - Compatibility settings.  The only one that does anything is disabling full screen optimizations.  That makes it so the menu isn't black and doesn't flicker, but then the menu font is stretched and where you click isn't accurate (ie. if trying to right click to create a new event, clicking "New" doesn't make a new event, have to click where new *should* be to get it to work).  So still broken.  See 2nd screenshot for what it looks like what full screen optimization disabled.

posts.author: james5272
posts.body:
Okay everyone, I think I found the fix. For Nvidia cards at least:
- Go into Nvidia Control Panel
- Manage 3D Settings (left side)
- On right side, choose Program Settings
- You will probably have to click Add and find RPGMZ.exe manually
- Under "2. Specify settings for this program", scroll down until you see Open GDI Compatibility
- Set it to Prefer compatible
- Click apply, give it a few seconds to make the change
- Now launch RPG Maker MZ with 1.9
So far it seems to have fixed the menus for me. I do *not* have to have the exe compatibility properties set to have fullscreen optimizations disabled anymore either.
And yes, I am on Feb. 13 drivers.  I was having the same issue on previous drivers.  With a 3070.

posts.author: gaminup
posts.body: Just chiming in--that worked! I have an NVIDIA card and I've been sticking to 1.8 ever since encountering the right click menu problem in 1.8.1, and setting "Prefer compatible" on Open GDI Compatibility for RPGMZ makes it work! I can finally upgrade, thank you!
